title: post-upgrade-nodegroup-credential-rotation-race-and-graceful-restore
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Summary: After an orchestrated on-prem operator + Helm chart upgrade for a large Dedicated customer, nodegroups intermittently lost access to tenant secrets during post-upgrade hooks. The resulting failure mode caused multiple tenant controllers to restart and one customer-facing inference cluster to enter a degraded state for ~47 minutes. This ticket tracks triage, an emergency conservative hotfix, QA validation, and a safe rollout plan for operator-2026.03.1.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Provision a VPC/private deployment with multi-tenant operator enabled and nodegroups pegged at 80% utilization.
2) Apply operator Helm chart bump from v1.18.4 -> v1.19.0 with post-upgrade hooks that trigger secret refresh and credential rotation.
3) Simulate slow kube-apiserver responses (200-800ms) and intermittent etcd hitches.
4) Observe that nodeagent requests for ExternalSecret reconciles sometimes timeout and the operator marks pods Unavailable, triggering immediate nodegroup rolling restarts.
observed_behavior: During the post-upgrade window the operator issued parallel secret-rotation reconciles across tenant controllers. Several agents retried with exponential backoff but the Helm post-upgrade hook considered the job failed after default timeout, causing a Helm release to be marked Failed and an operator reconcile to attempt aggressive corrective actions. This resulted in 2 tenant controllers restarting in rapid succession and one inference deployment dropping below its minimum ready replicas triggering a customer incident alert.
impact:
- One enterprise customer reported 47 minutes of degraded inference throughput and elevated latency.
- Platform SLOs for that region briefly violated latency and availability SLOs.
- Pager escalations to SE and CSM teams and a post-incident request for root cause analysis.

mitigation:
Immediate: paused all scheduled operator Helm upgrades in affected region and applied a manual rollback for the customer cluster. Increased Helm hook timeout on the cluster to prevent premature failure.
Short term: applied conservative patch to operator that serializes ExternalSecret reconcile jobs per-nodegroup and retries secret fetches with a longer overall deadline; added circuit-breaker to avoid cascading restarts.
Long term: replace blind parallel reconciles with a rate-limited coordinator and add operator-side idempotency markers for secret rotation jobs.
proposed_fix:
1) Operator change: add per-tenant reconcile lock and a single-flight mechanism so only one ExternalSecret refresh runs per nodegroup at a time.
2) Helm chart change: expose hook timeout and backoff parameters with sane defaults and document recommended values for high-latency clusters.
3) Add a safety gate in the reconciler: if more than 3 pods are Unavailable, escalate to safe-mode that pauses further rolling restarts and notifies oncall.
4) Backfill e2e tests that simulate API/etcd slowness and validate that hooks do not cause restart storms.
rollout_plan:
- Stage 1 (Canary): 1% of Dedicated clusters in region ap-south with low-risk tenants. Monitor for 48h for helm hook failures and restart rates.
- Stage 2: 20% of clusters with medium-tenancy, run for 24h.
- Stage 3: remaining clusters; adopt gradual ramp with automated rollback if restart rate > baseline + 2 sigma.
- Communication: notify CSMs and affected customers 24h prior to Stage 2 and provide rollback contact.
- Feature flag: ship operator change behind feature flag 'serialize-secret-reconciles' for quick disable if any regression.
test_plan:
- Unit tests for single-flight lock and idempotency markers.
- Integration tests: staging cluster with throttled apiserver, scripted helm upgrade, assert no >2 pod restarts within 10m window.
- Load test: synthetic tenants at 75-90% utilization for 60m during upgrade.
- Chaos test: inject etcd latency and ensure operator enters safe-mode instead of restarting controllers.
- Post-deploy smoke: validate secret reads succeed and no Helm hook jobs left in Failed state.
postmortem_actions:
- Complete rollout and observe for 7 days; collect restart telemetry.
- Update Console upgrade UI to warn when cluster apiserver latency >200ms recommending increased hook timeout.
- Add dashboard panel for Helm hook failure rate per-release.
- Run a cross-team retro with SRE, Operator, and Solutions within 2 weeks.
- Create a knowledge base article for CSMs explaining safe rollback steps and expected timings.
